identity: The Whispering Reedlands charge a toll for every crossing, and the mirefolk collect it.

quests.title: Do Not Follow Every Light
quests.text: Out here, a welcoming light can leave you waist-deep in water with someone demanding a toll. Kill six Wandering Wisps after dark in the {name:canopy} {zone_area:canopy}. I cannot prove they work for the toll collectors, but the collectors certainly appreciate the business.

quests.title: The Water Signed Nothing
quests.text: Toll Mirefolk have settled in the {name:hushwater_nests} {dir_from_giver:hushwater_nests} and decided every crossing belongs to them. Kill six before another traveller pays for the same stretch of water twice. I asked who gave them the river; they were strangely unwilling to introduce us.

quests.title: Where the Reeds Give Way
quests.text: A troll who knows only reeds will try to weave every problem into a basket. Visit Brakka Jarward at Speargrass Wellhold in Speargrass Reach, carry my greetings, and ask what work needs doing. Our orc kin may show you another use for those hands.

quests.title: Names That Outlast the Rain
quests.text: Rain takes the ink from my tallies, but our undead kin seem determined to remember everything. Travel to Ossuary Ledgerstead in Ossuary Reach and speak with Sovel Namekeeper about work. Give my greetings before giving your name, or you may end up filed among the supplies.

quests.title: That Is No Floating Log
quests.text: Two carts and a mule lost, and still somebody says the Reed Crocodiles look like logs. Kill six in the {name:mudbanks} {dir_from_giver:mudbanks}, where we haul our stone. They wait there day and night; at least one thing around this quarry never misses a shift.

quests.title: Quiet the Pumps
quests.text: The quarry pumps squeal loud enough to drown out the frogs, and the frogs have put years into that chorus. Bring me two Slime Gel to grease them, taken from the Bubbling Bog Oozes in the {name:hushmire} {dir_from_giver:hushmire}. The oozes are there day and night, making considerably less fuss than my machinery.

quests.title: Bounty: Jaws on the Haul Path
quests.text: Every flood leaves fresh Reed Crocodiles in the {name:mudbanks} {dir_from_giver:mudbanks}, and none has offered to pull a cart. Kill six there, by day or night, for this repeatable bounty. It opens again twenty minutes after you turn it in; stone waits patiently, but my haulers should not have to.

quests.title: Who Speaks for the Mire
quests.text: Listen to the {name:mire_nests} {dir_from_giver:mire_nests}: the reeds whisper, and the Toll Mirefolk shout over them. Kill six mirefolk there to weaken their tollkeeper's hold on these waters. We have heard quite enough about what we owe for crossing our own home.

quests.title: The River Has No Purse
quests.text: Mirefolk Tollkeeper Ush waits in the {name:mire_nests} {dir_from_giver:tollkeeper_ush}, demanding coin from everything that floats. Kill Ush and end that claim upon our waters. When the reeds whisper the tale, I want them to remember who stood up for the folk with empty hands.

quests.title: Let the Reeds Tell It
quests.text: You have given these waters a tale worth carrying, and I will see that it travels. Go to Tornstandard Hold on Bannerbreak Mesa and speak with Yarra Standardmender. The Throng needs hands like yours where the banners tear, as surely as we needed them among the reeds.
